jose/3d-space.title: 3D album artwork explorers
jose/3d-space.summary: Explore your album covers in Chronocity, Cover flow, Panels and Orbit.
highlights: Browse original covers on a folded shelf, through an angled gallery or around a spiral archive.
Expand playlists into collections of their actual album artworks.
Try cinematic camera tours and optional holographic artwork.
jose/3d-space.tryIt: Open Albums or Playlists and choose Cover flow, Panels or Orbit beside Chronocity. Scroll or drag to browse, use the year selector to jump, and choose Explore artwork on a playlist. Chronocity also offers Cinematic camera tours.
